author: Zintenka
body:
Well, I've managed to make a really decent map guys! After the events of my first "Spawner test map" and with the revelation that item spawners do in fact work and mob spawners don't, I've put together this awesome map using some rehashed structures from previous maps of mine. But I blended it together to make something worthwhile.

Part of being a good map maker is to take old forgotten stuff from one of your old forgotten maps and combine it to make something new ;)


Features
  • 32v32 (Bringing back higher player counts. It will potentially attract more players plus this gives a chance for EVERYONE to play out the map instead of unneeded scammers and a reduce in Avicus' population)
  • 5 monuments
  • Wither skull shoot_bow region at the center
  • Kills cause a custom kill sound to pop up
  • Spawner blocks
  • Kills give lapis blocks and 4 xp bottles!

Rehashed structures
  • Center Tower (Comes from one of my old maps "Shiver")
  • Spawns (Comes from an OCN map I released a year ago called "Until Dusk")
  • Monuments (From my last map, "Kugelblitz Strike I". I know this is very recent however, I believe that the monuments here were done very nicely. A hard to mine outside with a soft easy to mine inside)
  • Spectator spawn (Yeah, i love the spectator spawn i made in Kugelblitz. It can be used here xD)
Spawner blocks
  • 8 Iron spawners at each spawn (Located at spawn in the "Iron pits". Spawns 27 iron every 120 ticks)
  • TNT spawners (Located at the very top of the center tower, spawns 64 TNT every 120 ticks)
  • Dispenser Spawners (Located along with the TNT spawners, spawns 4 dispensers every 120 ticks)

Changelog v1.2
  • Made map thinner to make PVP encounters more common and Rushing harder
  • Reduced monument amount to encourage defending
  • Teleporter regions
  • A more "noticeable" monument (Seriously, how much more can 4 beacons signify that something special is there? I have to change them to tall towers to get you guys to know where they are?)
  • Signs by the "Back" monument that give you supplies if you right-click them
